title: Supplier Delay Escalation Policy
content: Any supplier delay exceeding 3 calendar days requires an escalation review. When inventory coverage is below the safety stock threshold, the category is elevated and procurement must initiate contingency planning.

title: Supplier Performance Management
content: Suppliers with a delivery reliability score below 0.85 over the last six months are monitored for corrective action. Repeat late deliveries above 20% trigger action review.

title: Inventory Risk and Stockout Policy
content: If the projected days of supply fall below the safety stock threshold, the business should trigger contingency procurement, expedite shipments, or source alternate supply.
